propertySets.name: Pset_CommunicationsApplianceTypeComputer
propertySets.definition: Properties common to a computer. This property set is applied to a type or occurrence of IfcCommunicationsAppliance with predefined type of COMPUTER.

properties.name: StorageCapacity
properties.definition: Indicates the total data storage capacity of the device. It is defined by bytes.

properties.name: UserInterfaceType
properties.definition: Indicates the user interface of the computer.
